Class PlayerDataKey<T>

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.player.PlayerDataKey<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class PlayerDataKey<T> extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
A value MachineEngine keeps for each player (D37), declared by an addon in its own namespace and registered with RegistrationContext#playerData(). Read and written through MachinePlayer.get(PlayerDataKey)/MachinePlayer.set(PlayerDataKey, T). Values must be immutable. 
public static final PlayerDataKey<Double> DOSE = PlayerDataKey.persistent(Key.key("mymod", "dose"),
        VersionedCodec.builder(Key.key("mymod", "dose"), Codecs.DOUBLE).build(), 0.0).resetOnDeath();
public static final PlayerDataKey<Long> LAST_TELEPORT = PlayerDataKey.session(Key.key("mymod", "last_teleport"), 0L);

Keys are immutable: resetOnDeath, migratePdc(String, PersistentDataType) and display return a new key.
